_note: Placeholder ANSI K-factor bands by material and gauge thickness, pending real shop/material-supplier data. Widely-cited rule-of-thumb approximations (K roughly 0.33 for thin gauge up to roughly 0.44+ for thick gauge on mild steel, adjusted per material family here), NOT certified values -- replace with your shop's actual measured/supplied K-factors before using this for production parts. Each material's bands are checked in ascending thickness_max order; a part's thickness uses the first band whose thickness_max is >= its thickness. A thickness beyond every band's thickness_max falls back to the last (largest) band and is reported as extrapolated.
